Low density residential zone.title: Queensland Housing Code, Chapter 2 (lots 450 m² and over)
Low density residential zone.note: These are the Queensland Housing Code defaults (from 1 September 2026). Brisbane's City Plan (v37, 2026) still refers to the older QDC MP 1.1 and MP 1.2 rules for these lots, so the distances that apply here may be different. Do not rely on these numbers until council confirms them.

rows.label: Front, garage door, detached laundry or shed
Side, ground floor or wall up to 4.5 m
Side, wall over 4.5 m up to 8.5 m
Rear, ground floor or wall up to 4.5 m
Rear, wall over 4.5 m up to 8.5 m
Detached single-storey secondary dwelling (up to 4.5 m): side / rear

Low density residential zone.check: Corner lots (secondary road frontage), laneway lots, lots under 450 m² and special-area lots: check with council.
